text:
sarah (people-ops): Heads up — need routing for an offer exception. Candidate expects a tiered sign-on (60% now / 40% after 6 months) and we want to bump them one comp band for market parity. Can we get approvals + cost routing?
kevin (recruiter): Candidate: Priya N, IC3 -> Manager role. Base ask $165k (band midpoint is $150k). Requesting 1-band uplift to IC4 and $20k sign-on split as above. Hiring manager ok'd. :eyes:
jordan (hiring-manager): Confirmed. Strong market candidate, lost two prior offers for comp reasons. Need uplift to match competitor comp. Start date target 2026-05-04 but can be flexible by 1–2 weeks.
maya (comp): Quick Q: Is the uplift permanent or a one-time market adjustment? Also need justification doc (benchmarks / comp rationale).
jordan (hiring-manager): Permanent uplift to IC4. Rationale: heavy technical depth + specialized infra experience; bench: similar roles at 160–175k in our region. I uploaded a short note to the hire ticket.
kevin (recruiter): Uploaded comp rationale + competitor offers screenshot to the hire ticket: https://redwood.hire/REQ-4521 (private).
raj (finance): We need cost center and FY proration for the sign-on split — which budgets absorb the 40% deferred piece? If it crosses fiscal quarter we need chargeback plan.
sarah (people-ops): Finance: charge to Eng Hiring FY26 pooled hiring budget for the initial 60%. Deferred 40% will be expensed in FY27 unless manager confirms headcount carry. Also confirm if the 40% should be paid as retention bonus or lump sign-on.
lisa (legal): Any visa/relocation constraints? If start date is after a new visa issuance we need to confirm EOR/immigration timing before payout schedule agreed.
kevin (recruiter): Candidate on H1B transfer; visa window likely mid-June earliest. They asked for 60% upfront to cover relocation, the rest as retention.
payroll-bot: payroll-check: flagged — multi-part sign-ons need separate expense IDs and retention agreement. Please attach PO# or approval before payout.
maya (comp): I can approve 1-band uplift conditional on the written market rationale + manager attestation of no internal equity impact. For the sign-on, approve up to $20k split 60/40 if payroll holds and legal ok on visa timing.
jordan (hiring-manager): I can provide attestation. No direct reports in-scope for parity concerns.
sarah (people-ops): Next steps: kevin to confirm visa timeline and candidate acceptance window; jordan to post manager attestation in the ticket; finance to confirm charge codes; comp (maya) will route to comp-reviewers for formal sign-off. Once comp approves, I'll route to payroll for PO and retention agreement.
kevin (recruiter): Candidate verbally accepts subject to final offer. I'll ask for written acceptance and update visa ETA.
raj (finance): Charge codes: ENG-HIRING-FY26 / deferred: ENG-RET-FY27 — confirm when final.
maya (comp): Routing now to comp-committee: @comp-committee — please review IC4 uplift + $20k tiered sign-on. Docs: hire ticket + market note attached.
sarah (people-ops): tagging payroll and legal once comp-committee responds. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
kevin (recruiter): FYI — candidate requested first payout at start date instead of sign-on now if visa delays beyond 6 weeks. Will update.
lisa (legal): Noted — we'll need language in the retention agreement for deferred payout and visa contingency.
maya (comp): provisional approval from comp chair (via DM) — will post full thread decision once committee meets tomorrow.
sarah (people-ops): Great. Closing for now — will reopen thread when comp decision posted.
